verdict.rationale: Claude offers file/data upload analysis (PDF, CSV, XLSX, DOCX), Research mode that agentically investigates and synthesizes insights with citations, Artifacts for generating visualizations/tools from data, and Cowork/Projects for synthesizing research and delivering reports from user data/connectors like Drive/Gmail. This directly matches the story of generating AI insights/suggestions from the user's own data inside the product. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarks specifically validating insight quality on user-uploaded data, and no dedicated 'analytics/insights dashboard' feature distinct from chat-based analysis.
